subject.title: fix: strip volatile output from exec result hash to fix no-progress detection (#93917)

question: Should stable failed exec retries ignore volatile output and be allowed to trip critical/global blocking after the configured threshold?
rationale: The patch is narrow, but it deliberately changes when repeated failed exec attempts stop an agent, so maintainer intent is needed for the availability tradeoff.

options.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
options.body: Merge after the docs follow-up and exact-head validation if maintainers agree stable failed exec outcomes should stop runaway sessions.

options.title: Defer For Broader Loop Policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want to settle session-wide or fuzzy loop-detection semantics before changing failed-exec hashing.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
recommendation.body: Merge after the docs follow-up and exact-head validation if maintainers agree stable failed exec outcomes should stop runaway sessions.
